extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners / attorneys seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; Office of Enrollment and Discipline stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Filing and adjudication of a petition to reinstate an individual to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, supported by an affidavit under 37 CFR §11.58 and reviewed by the Director of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (dated and filed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Karl L. Larson dated November 22, 2016.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal, dated petition for reinstatement should be submitted to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; the Director will consider the petition as part of the reinstatement review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR §11.58 in support of petition
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Larson filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR §11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit conforming to 37 CFR §11.58 is submitted to support the petition; the affidavit is considered alongside the petition during the Director's review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review and determination of appropriateness for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, and supporting affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director evaluates the petition and supporting materials and makes a discretionary determination whether reinstatement is appropriate; if so, the petition will be granted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuance of order and service/copy to parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED. Copy to: Mr. Karl L. Larson ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reinstatement is granted, an order is issued by the Office (signed by the Deputy General Counsel/Director) and a copy of the decision is provided to the petitioner and listed recipients.
